en.title: A rested Rangers team gets the Metro leaders on the second night of a back-to-back
en.deck: Carolina leads the Metropolitan Division at 17-3-3 and scored seven against Edmonton on Saturday, but it plays again 24 hours later at Madison Square Garden. The Rangers have won three straight and six of seven and come in after five days off. The market makes Carolina a clear favourite; the model sees a near coin flip.
news: Nikolaj Ehlers (22 points in 23 games) got hurt against Edmonton, did not travel and is out. Brandon Bussi, 2-0 in his career against New York, is expected in goal after Pyotr Kochetkov played Saturday.
Rangers: Sean Durzi has missed eight games and is a game-time decision. Oliver Bjorkstrand is out two to three months, and Igor Shesterkin is out for the season.
New York added forward Max Sasson in a trade with Vancouver. Coach Mike Sullivan called Carolina the standard of the league.
This is the first of three meetings in 17 days. The teams meet again on Nov. 30 in New York and Dec. 8 in Raleigh.
records: Sebastian Aho's 323rd goal moved him alone into second place on the franchise list. He and Andrei Svechnikov share the team lead with 13 goals.
Carolina's five-goal second period turned Saturday's game into a 7-4 win. The Hurricanes have scored 5.2 goals a game over their last five.
Adam Fox leads the Rangers with 24 points in 22 games.
Sean Walker is set to play his 500th NHL game. The last 11 meetings averaged only 4.7 goals.

sv.deck: Carolina leder Metropolitan-divisionen med 17-3-3 och gjorde sju mål mot Edmonton i lördags, men spelar igen bara ett dygn senare i Madison Square Garden. Rangers har vunnit tre raka och sex av sju och har haft fem dagar ledigt. Marknaden har Carolina som klar favorit, modellen ser en ren slantsingling.
news: Nikolaj Ehlers (22 poäng på 23 matcher) skadades mot Edmonton, följde inte med och spelar inte. Brandon Bussi, som har vunnit båda sina karriärmatcher mot New York, väntas stå sedan Pyotr Kochetkov spelade i lördags.
Rangers: Sean Durzi har missat åtta matcher och avgörs först vid matchstart. Oliver Bjorkstrand är borta i två till tre månader, och Igor Shesterkin är skadad för säsongen.

en.title: Buffalo returns to the scene of an 8-3 beating, a day after a late loss in Florida
en.deck: Tampa Bay hammered Buffalo 8-3 eleven days ago behind a third-period hat trick from Nikita Kucherov. The Sabres arrive on the back end of a back-to-back after Saturday's 4-3 loss in Sunrise, and they have not won two in a row since late October. Model and market agree that the Lightning are clear favourites.
news: Lightning: Brandon Hagel, tied with Jake Guentzel for the team lead with 13 goals, is on injured reserve. Conor Geekie is also out and Zemgus Girgensons is day-to-day. Brayden Point, Anthony Cirelli and Erik Cernak returned on Nov. 17.
Buffalo lost 4-3 in Florida on Saturday. Sam Bennett had a hat trick and Sandis Vilmanis scored the winner with 3:18 left. Tage Thompson scored his 15th goal.
Alex Lyon was expected to start in Florida, which points to Ukko-Pekka Luukkonen for Sunday. That is not confirmed. Luukkonen was pulled after five goals on 14 shots in the Nov. 11 meeting.
Sabres: Konsta Helenius, Matt Grzelcyk and Justin Danforth are on injured reserve.
records: In the 8-3 win on Nov. 11, Kucherov scored three times in the third period for his eighth career hat trick. John Carlson had five points and Guentzel four assists.
Tampa Bay reached 10 home wins on Thursday, tying 2020-21 as the fastest in club history.
Jack Quinn entered the weekend with 11 goals, nine short of his career high, and scored again on Saturday.
The last 12 meetings averaged 7.8 goals.

Sabres spelar andra matchen på två dagar efter lördagens 3-4 i Sunrise och har inte vunnit två raka sedan slutet av oktober. Modellen och marknaden är eniga om att Lightning är klar favorit.
news: Lightning: Brandon Hagel, som delar lagets skytteliga med Jake Guentzel på 13 mål, är skadad. Conor Geekie är också borta och Zemgus Girgensons är osäker. Brayden Point, Anthony Cirelli och Erik Cernak kom tillbaka den 17 november.

Tampa Bay nådde tio hemmasegrar i torsdags och tangerade 2020-21 som snabbast i klubbens historia.

en.title: Draisaitl one point from 1,100 as Edmonton tries to stop a two-game slide
en.deck: Both teams played on Saturday: Edmonton blew a 2-0 lead in a 7-4 loss in Carolina, while St. Louis beat New Jersey 9-6 for its first three-game winning streak of the season. Leon Draisaitl needs one point for 1,100 in his career. The market sees a coin flip; the model leans to the Blues.
news: Mike Babcock after the loss in Raleigh: "they had the crowbars and we had the noodles." Edmonton (17-5-3) has lost two straight after six wins in a row.
Zach Hyman left Saturday's game with a migraine but is likely to play. Ryan Nugent-Hopkins has missed four games and returns on Tuesday. Frederik Andersen is still out.
Jordan Binnington made 37 saves on Saturday, so Joel Hofer (.923) is the likely Blues starter. Daily Faceoff projects Tristan Jarry for Edmonton.
Blues: Dillon Dube and Tyler Tucker are out, and Connor McMichael is day-to-day.
records: Draisaitl leads the NHL with 22 goals. His 643 assists moved him past Mark Messier into third place in Oilers history.
McDavid's season-opening 23-game point streak ended on Thursday. Last week he tied Wayne Gretzky as the fastest to 40 assists in a season (22 games).
Jake Neighbours had five assists on Saturday, tying the Blues record, and Robert Thomas has three straight three-point games. St. Louis has scored eight or more in two straight home games.
Edmonton's power play runs at 33.8%, second in the league. The Blues won the last meeting 3-2 in March.

en.title: Pittsburgh brings a three-game skid into Dallas without Malkin
en.deck: The Penguins lost 4-3 in Nashville on Saturday, their third straight defeat, and now face a Dallas team that has won four in a row. Pittsburgh is 7-13-2 and plays the second half of a back-to-back, but it did win the only meeting so far, 2-1 on Oct. 10. The market makes Dallas a big favourite; the model is a bit warmer on Pittsburgh.
news: Evgeni Malkin is out again. Bryan Rust is skating in a non-contact jersey, and Nick Robertson is on injured reserve.
Sergei Murashov played in Nashville, so Arturs Silovs (5-7-1, .873) is the likely starter, though it is not confirmed. Jake Oettinger is 12-4-1 with four shutouts.

Stars: Tyler Myers is out with an upper-body injury, and Matt Duchene is out after core surgery in October that was expected to sideline him for about three months. Miro Heiskanen returned on Nov. 17 and scored the overtime winner against Vegas.
Pittsburgh is 2-3-1 on the second night of back-to-backs this season.
records: Dallas has won four straight, the last two against Vegas (4-3 in OT and 4-3 in a shootout, with Tyler Seguin scoring the deciding goal).
Wyatt Johnston has goals in four straight games. Mikko Rantanen leads Dallas with 27 points.
Only 36% of Dallas games this season have gone over 5.5 goals.
Erik Karlsson leads Pittsburgh with 19 points (16 assists). Tommy Novak leads the team with eight goals.

en.title: Boeser's 10-game point streak meets a Chicago team that finally won on the road
en.deck: Both teams won on Saturday: Chicago got its first road win of the season in overtime in Calgary, and Vancouver ended an eight-game home losing streak in a shootout against Minnesota. Now they meet on the second night of back-to-backs, with neither Connor Bedard nor Elias Pettersson in the lineup. The market has it 50–50; the model leans to the home team.
news: Sam Rinzel scored with 15 seconds left in overtime for a 4-3 win in Calgary. Chicago had been 0-8-1 on the road. Patrick Kane and Roman Kantserov had three points each.
Bedard will have surgery on his right shoulder, with no timeline yet. Anton Frondell missed the third period on Saturday and his status is unclear. Drew Commesso could make his season debut in goal.

Canucks: Pettersson (upper body) is expected to miss both weekend games, and Brendan Gallagher and Thatcher Demko are on injured reserve. Nikita Tolopilo, who won his only NHL start, is expected in goal.
Vancouver traded Max Sasson to the Rangers and recalled two forwards. Marco Rossi scored twice against Minnesota and Jake DeBrusk won the shootout.
records: Brock Boeser has a 10-game point streak after three assists on Saturday.
Rinzel has five straight games with multiple assists, the fourth-longest such streak by a defenceman in NHL history.
Kane now has 563 goals including playoffs, past Joe Mullen for fourth among U.S.-born players. Jeremy Roenick and Keith Tkachuk are three ahead at 566.
The last nine meetings averaged 6.4 goals, and both teams have gone over 5.5 in about two thirds of their games this season.

sv.deck: Båda lagen vann i lördags: Chicago tog säsongens första bortaseger efter förlängning i Calgary, och Vancouver bröt åtta raka hemmaförluster efter straffar mot Minnesota. Nu möts de på andra kvällen i rad för båda, utan Connor Bedard och Elias Pettersson. Marknaden ser 50–50, modellen lutar åt hemmalaget.
news: Sam Rinzel avgjorde 15 sekunder före slutet av förlängningen till 4-3 i Calgary. Chicago hade 0-8-1 på bortaplan dessförinnan. Patrick Kane och Roman Kantserov gjorde tre poäng var.
Bedard ska opereras i höger axel, ingen tidsplan finns ännu. Anton Frondell missade tredje perioden i lördags och hans status är oklar. Drew Commesso kan göra säsongsdebut i målet.
Canucks: Pettersson (överkropp) väntas missa båda helgens matcher, och Brendan Gallagher och Thatcher Demko är skadade. Nikita Tolopilo, som vann sin enda NHL-start, väntas stå.
Vancouver tradade Max Sasson till Rangers och kallade upp två forwards. Marco Rossi gjorde två mål mot Minnesota och Jake DeBrusk avgjorde straffläggningen.
records: Brock Boeser har gjort poäng i tio raka matcher efter tre assist i lördags.

Kane har nu 563 mål inklusive slutspel och har passerat Joe Mullen som fyra bland USA-födda spelare. Jeremy Roenick och Keith Tkachuk ligger tre mål före på 566.
De nio senaste mötena hade i snitt 6,4 mål, och båda lagen har gått över 5,5 i ungefär två tredjedelar av sina matcher den här säsongen.
